method.trend: site linear sea-level trend is fit after removing monthly seasonal effects from cached monthly mean sea level
method.futureFit: empirical residual exceedance probabilities evaluated at jurisdiction sea-level scenario deltas
method.uncertainty: analytical binomial p05/p50/p95 count approximation for annual high-tide draws; no Monte Carlo sampling
method.bins: exclusive nearFlood/minor/moderate/major NAVD88 threshold bins; nearFlood is within 0.5 ft below minor flooding
